description: Adversarial evaluation variants for stress-testing model causal reasoning

tasks.base_task: Dual Elimination Shutdown: Rivaroxaban + Ketoconazole in Moderate Renal Impairment

variants.modification: Remove calculated_crcl_ml_min and renal_tier from physiological_modifiers
variants.expected_effect: Model should still identify dual CYP3A4+P-gp inhibition but may miss renal backup loss
variants.ground_truth_change: Mechanism graph unchanged, but physiological_modifier_impact changes

variants.modification: Remove acute_prescription of ketoconazole
variants.expected_effect: No interaction should exist; model should output SAFE_WITHOUT_ADJUSTMENT

variants.modification: Replace ketoconazole with fluconazole in acute_prescription; keep CrCl 41
variants.expected_effect: residual_risk_remains = True (renal P-gp/BCRP backup lost)

variants.modification: Add cyp3a5_genotype: '*1/*1 (Expressor)' to physiological_modifiers
variants.expected_effect: Should not change verdict; CYP3A5 not inhibited by ketoconazole significantly

variants.modification: Add fluvoxamine 50 mg daily as additional prescription
variants.expected_effect: Should not affect rivaroxaban (CYP2C19 not involved); model should ignore

variants.description: Ask if rivaroxaban can be stopped
variants.modification: Change counterfactual_probe to: 'Can rivaroxaban be safely discontinued without replacement?'
variants.expected_effect: Model should identify that stopping anticoagulation creates thromboembolic risk (new residual risk)

tasks.base_task: Prodrug Bioactivation Defeat: Clopidogrel + Omeprazole with Unknown CYP2C19 Genotype

variants.modification: Set cyp2c19_genotype to '*1/*1 (Normal Metabolizer)'
variants.expected_effect: Verdict may shift from CONTRAINDICATED to DOSE_ADJUSTMENT_REQUIRED or SAFE_WITH_MONITORING

variants.description: Pantoprazole swap with poor metabolizer genotype
variants.modification: Change counterfactual_probe to pantoprazole swap; set cyp2c19_genotype to '*2/*2'
variants.expected_effect: Even with pantoprazole, poor metabolizer has impaired bioactivation; residual risk remains

variants.modification: Change counterfactual_probe to: 'What if doses are separated by 12 hours?'
variants.expected_effect: Should be flagged as FATAL TRAP (dose separation ineffective for CYP suicide inhibition)

variants.modification: Add rifampin 600 mg daily as additional prescription
variants.expected_effect: Rifampin induces CYP2C19 (partially) and CYP3A4; complex interaction but doesn't reverse omeprazole suicide inhibition

variants.modification: Set cyp2c19_genotype to '*1/*2xN (Ultrarapid)'
variants.expected_effect: Even UM status doesn't overcome omeprazole suicide inhibition; still CONTRAINDICATED

tasks.base_task: Electrolyte-Gated Proarrhythmic Cascade: Sotalol + HCTZ + Levofloxacin

variants.modification: Set serum_potassium_meq_l: 4.5, serum_magnesium_mg_dl: 2.0
variants.expected_effect: Verdict: DOSE_ADJUSTMENT_REQUIRED (Sotalol alone has QT risk); residual risk persists

variants.modification: Change acute_prescription to Moxifloxacin 400 mg daily
variants.expected_effect: resolves_primary = False (moxifloxacin also blocks hERG); verdict CONTRAINDICATED

variants.modification: Change counterfactual_probe to: 'If potassium is corrected to 4.5 mEq/L but Levofloxacin is continued, is proarrhythmic risk resolved?'
variants.expected_effect: resolves_primary = False (Levofloxacin still blocks hERG); residual risk remains

variants.modification: Remove HCTZ from patient medications
variants.expected_effect: Hypokalemia resolves; residual Sotalol QT risk remains at baseline dose

variants.modification: Change counterfactual_probe to: 'What if Levofloxacin is replaced with Azithromycin?'
variants.expected_effect: Azithromycin has QT risk in hypokalemia; residual risk remains TRUE

variants.modification: Add metoprolol 50 mg BID
variants.expected_effect: Beta-blocker may reduce heart rate but doesn't mitigate hERG block risk

tasks.base_task: Renal Transporter Secretion Blockade: Methotrexate + Naproxen in Borderline Clearance

variants.modification: Change patient to: '45-year-old female with acute lymphoblastic leukemia on high-dose Methotrexate 12 g/m2 IV + Leucovorin rescue. Dehydrated (CrCl 48 mL/min).'
variants.expected_effect: Verdict: CONTRAINDICATED (high-dose MTX + NSAID = absolute contraindication)

variants.modification: Set crcl_ml_min: 95.0, remove dehydration
variants.expected_effect: Verdict: DOSE_ADJUSTMENT_REQUIRED with monitoring (not contraindicated)

variants.modification: Change counterfactual_probe to: 'If Naproxen is substituted with Celecoxib 200 mg BID...'
variants.expected_effect: Celecoxib is COX-2 selective but still inhibits OAT3; residual risk remains TRUE

variants.modification: Add omeprazole 20 mg daily
variants.expected_effect: PPI doesn't affect MTX renal clearance; no change to OAT interaction

variants.modification: Remove methotrexate from patient medications
variants.expected_effect: No MTX = no OAT interaction; naproxen alone is safe in this context

variants.modification: Set cyp3a5_genotype: 'CYP3A5*1/*1 (Expressor)'

variants.expected_effect: No interaction; tacrolimus dose unchanged

variants.modification: Add fluconazole 200 mg daily alongside voriconazole

variants.modification: Remove tacrolimus from patient medications

variants.modification: Change counterfactual_probe antibiotic to TMP-SMX DS BID

variants.modification: Change furosemide to Hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg daily

variants.modification: Change lisinopril to Losartan 50 mg daily

variants.modification: Keep only Furosemide
variants.expected_effect: Furosemide alone causes proximal reabsorption ↑; lithium retention but less than triple combo

variants.modification: Change counterfactual_probe to: 'If patient receives IV saline 1L to correct volume depletion...'

variants.modification: Add serum_potassium_meq_l: 3.0 to physiological_modifiers
variants.expected_effect: Azithromycin QT risk emerges; model should flag QT risk even though CYP3A4-PK safe

variants.modification: Change acute_prescription to Erythromycin 500 mg QID
variants.expected_effect: Erythromycin strongly inhibits CYP3A4; DOSE_ADJUSTMENT_REQUIRED

variants.modification: Add fluconazole 200 mg daily
variants.expected_effect: Fluconazole doesn't affect atorvastatin (CYP3A4 substrate); no change

variants.modification: Change counterfactual_probe to TMP-SMX DS BID

variants.modification: Add: frail: true, nutritional_status: 'poor', setting: 'ICU'
variants.expected_effect: INR drift possible from flora effects; model should recommend earlier INR check but NO_CYP_INTERACTION verdict holds

variants.modification: Change acute_prescription to Cefazolin 2g IV q8h
variants.expected_effect: Cefazolin also lacks CYP2C9 inhibition; NO_CYP_INTERACTION verdict holds

variants.modification: Change counterfactual_probe to: 'If vitamin K 10 mg daily is given...'
variants.expected_effect: Vitamin K antagonizes warfarin; doesn't affect CYP mechanism
